<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 114.068 corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~113.0608 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈6.7 % M+1, ≈0.6 % M+2) matches a composition containing six carbons and two oxygens. The formula C₆H₉O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 113.060255 Da, which when protonated yields 114.067531 Da, matching the observed m/z within experimental error. Therefore the molecular formula is C6H9O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
